# Founder decision evaluation (generated by `python evals/founder_cases.py`)

Six TEST_ONLY founders run through the same deterministic decision code. No model, no network: reproducible.
Expectations are written in `evals/founder_cases.py` before running; `tests/test_founder_eval.py` enforces them.

Distinct decision paths: **6 of 6** founders. Expectations met: **6 of 6**.

| Founder | Verdict (code) | Riskiest claim | Method chosen | Prototype | Commercial | Confidence | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| StudyFlow: study planner, Cairo students | NEEDS_EVIDENCE | C-DEM | concierge | Deadline Planner (planner) | COLLECT PRICE EVIDENCE before relying on this plan | NONE | PASS |
| Freelancer client tracker, one week, no coding | CONTINUE_TESTING | C-COMP | switching_trial | Client Project Tracker (tracker) | COLLECT PRICE EVIDENCE before relying on this plan | LOW | PASS |
| Barber booking app, strong demand, no engineering skill | CONTINUE_TESTING | C-VIAB | price_split | Appointment Booker (booking) | REDUCE SCOPE: this plan does not fit your stated budget | MODERATE | PASS |
| Weak evidence: polished pitch, background sources only | NEEDS_EVIDENCE | C-DEM | neutral_opt_in | Listing Finder (directory) | - | NONE | PASS |
| Adverse result: critical locked test failed | STOP_DO_NOT_LAUNCH | - | REVIEW_CRITICAL_RESULT_BEFORE_MORE_TESTS | - | - | NONE | PASS |
| Safety hard stop: crypto signals with guaranteed returns | BLOCK_DO_NOT_LAUNCH | - | NO_EXPERIMENT_SAFETY_BLOCK | - | - | NOT_APPLICABLE | PASS |

## Per founder

### StudyFlow: study planner, Cairo students

- Decision: Test C-DEM (demand) next: Concierge test: deliver the core result by hand to a few people and see if they come back.
- Evidence counted: none; excluded rows: 0
- Founder fit: Stated budget 1000 EGP; below the TEAM_ASSUMPTION floor of 5000 EGP for any paid test. Only no-spend methods are proposed. Stated skills include web/coding, so a self-built page is feasible.
- Options rejected: One-page description with an opt-in button that you build yourself; Neutral description shown in person or by message, with an opt-in; Small paid-ad smoke test; Build the full product now
- Success criterion: At least 30% of at least 10 relevant participants take the action within 14 days (STARTING ASSUMPTION: you choose and lock the real numbers before collecting results).
- Commercial findings: PRICE_UNSUPPORTED, CHURN_SENSITIVITY

### Freelancer client tracker, one week, no coding

- Decision: Test C-COMP (competition) next: Switching trial against the current workaround (uses the DEMO prototype).
- Evidence counted: TEST_ONLY-b1, TEST_ONLY-b2; excluded rows: 0
- Founder fit: Stated budget 50 USD; below the TEAM_ASSUMPTION floor of 100 USD for any paid test. Only no-spend methods are proposed. No web/coding skill stated: methods that need you to build software are excluded; use the FounderOS DEMO prototype or manual delivery. Short timeline (7 day(s)): one narrow test only; no full product build before this result.
- Options rejected: Side-by-side task: same task with the current tool and with a paper or demo version; Build the full product now
- Success criterion: At least 30% of at least 10 relevant participants take the action within 7 days (STARTING ASSUMPTION: you choose and lock the real numbers before collecting results).
- Commercial findings: PRICE_UNSUPPORTED, CHURN_SENSITIVITY

### Barber booking app, strong demand, no engineering skill

- Decision: Test C-VIAB (viability) next: Two-price commitment test across two comparable groups.
- Evidence counted: TEST_ONLY-b1, TEST_ONLY-b2, TEST_ONLY-b3; excluded rows: 0
- Founder fit: Stated budget 3000 EGP; below the TEAM_ASSUMPTION floor of 5000 EGP for any paid test. Only no-spend methods are proposed. No web/coding skill stated: methods that need you to build software are excluded; use the FounderOS DEMO prototype or manual delivery. Stated people-facing skills help with recruiting and interviewing participants.
- Options rejected: Single-price, no-payment commitment; Refundable real-money deposit; Build the full product now
- Success criterion: At least 30% of at least 10 relevant participants take the action within 14 days (STARTING ASSUMPTION: you choose and lock the real numbers before collecting results).
- Commercial findings: OVER_BUDGET, CHURN_SENSITIVITY

### Weak evidence: polished pitch, background sources only

- Decision: Test C-DEM (demand) next: Neutral description shown in person or by message, with an opt-in.
- Evidence counted: TEST_ONLY-q1, TEST_ONLY-s1; excluded rows: 5
- Founder fit: Budget not stated: the plan assumes no money is spent. Only no-spend methods are proposed. Skills not stated: methods that need you to build software are excluded until you state them.
- Options rejected: Concierge test: deliver the core result by hand to a few people and see if they come back; One-page description with an opt-in button that you build yourself; Small paid-ad smoke test; Build the full product now
- Success criterion: At least 30% of at least 10 relevant participants take the action within 7 days (STARTING ASSUMPTION: you choose and lock the real numbers before collecting results).

### Adverse result: critical locked test failed

- Decision: Stop and review the failed critical test before anything else.
- Evidence counted: TEST_ONLY-r1; excluded rows: 0
- Options rejected: REPEAT the same test; PIVOT to the recorded alternative; Continue building

### Safety hard stop: crypto signals with guaranteed returns

- Decision: Do not pursue this venture as described.
- Evidence counted: TEST_ONLY-b1; excluded rows: 0
- Options rejected: Remove the prohibited element and re-screen a revised brief

## Rubric and limits

- Checked automatically: verdict, riskiest claim, chosen method, rejected options, founder-fit reasons, prototype type and QA, commercial finding, exclusion of weak evidence, no validation claim, safety block.
- Not checked automatically: the quality of wording, or whether a real founder finds the advice useful. That needs real founders.
- Fixtures are synthetic (TEST_ONLY). Passing shows the logic reacts to different inputs as specified; it is not evidence about any market.
